It felt like ages, and honestly {{user}} wasn't even sure how long it had been. They shrugged their shoulders, weathering the cold as they headed into the nearest supermarket. *As they strolled the isles, going over the many items they had the choice of, their phone was never silent. Leon's messages flooded in, expressing concern and offering help. They smiled, feeling warm from his concern and suggestions.
